verified_facts.text: The resort's architecture is influenced by Frank Lloyd Wright, and it has been a Phoenix landmark since 1929.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our resort, with architecture influenced by Frank Lloyd Wright, has been a Phoenix icon since 1929.

verified_facts.text: The grounds cover 39 acres of desert gardens and reflect the design legacy of Frank Lloyd Wright and his protege Albert Chase McArthur.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on an architectural adventure across 39 acres of desert gardens, winding pathways, and iconic architecture at the Arizona Biltmore.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the grounds' geometric patterns and signature Biltmore Blocks on an architectural walk.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’ll encounter geometric patterns, signature Biltmore Blocks, tranquil courtyards

verified_facts.text: The resort has seven swimming pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: With seven unique pools, luxury cabanas, poolside dining, and curated events and activities

verified_facts.text: Catalina Pool is a resort landmark where famous guests from Marilyn Monroe to Frank Sinatra have gathered.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many famous people have gathered around its waters, from Marilyn Monroe to Frank Sinatra.

verified_facts.text: Saguaro Pool is reserved for adults.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Saguaro Pool, where only adults are allowed

verified_facts.text: Paradise Pool, aimed at families, has a splash pad, a triple 65-foot waterslide and a swim-up bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Splash through the dedicated splash pad, race down a triple 65 foot waterslide, enjoy refreshments from the swim-up bar

verified_facts.text: Paradise Pool hosts Movies at the Pool on Friday nights in summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Movies at the Pool after sunset every Friday night in the summer

verified_facts.text: Saguaro Pool is home to a 140-year-old cactus named Lloyd.
verified_facts.excerpt: admire our 140-year-old cactus, Lloyd

verified_facts.text: Tierra Luna Spa's treatments and rituals center on desert botanicals, cosmic connection and dynamic recovery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our treatments and rituals center on desert botanicals, cosmic connection, and dynamic recovery.

verified_facts.text: Access to the spa's outdoor Sol Garden is included with any 50-minute treatment at Tierra Luna Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to the refreshing tranquility of Sol Garden is offered with any 50-minute treatment enjoyed at the Tierra Luna Spa.

verified_facts.text: The spa has an outdoor hot tub and cold plunge, a steam room, and indoor and outdoor treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Outdoor Hot Tub

& Cold Plunge

Steam Room

Indoor & Outdoor Treatment Rooms

verified_facts.text: Wrigley Mansion, a historic hilltop destination with Christopher's, Geordie's Restaurant and Jamie's Wine Bar, is now part of the Arizona Biltmore experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Now part of the Arizona Biltmore experience, this historic hilltop destination also offers distinctive settings for private dining, weddings and special occasions.

verified_facts.text: Renata's Hearth hosts Latin evenings centered on fire and flavor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us in this enchanting setting for lively Latin evenings and share the delights of fire and flavor, spirit, and aromatic wonder.

verified_facts.text: McArthur's Restaurant & Bar, formerly Frank & Albert's, serves New American food.
verified_facts.excerpt: Formerly known as Frank & Albert’s, this reimagined restaurant celebrates a century of great taste with New American flavors

verified_facts.text: Cup & Cone is an art deco inspired cafe with espresso, homemade gelato and desserts.
verified_facts.excerpt: A new art deco inspired café offering hand roasted espresso and coffee beverages, homemade gelato and gourmet desserts.

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available 24 hours daily.

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to two championship golf courses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our pet-friendly rooms plus access to two championship golf courses

verified_facts.text: Rooms are pet-friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our pet-friendly rooms

verified_facts.text: The resort has tennis and pickleball courts with Har-Tru tennis courts and coaching from PBI coaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take your game to the next level at our new tennis and pickleball courts. Train with our PBI coaches

verified_facts.text: The fitness center offers Peloton bikes, a TRX station, free weights and fitness classes, and a personal trainer is available.
verified_facts.excerpt: For individual training, a personal trainer is available at the Biltmore.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation includes guest rooms, suites, villas and cottages.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find your home away from home in our glamorous guest rooms, alluring suites, spacious villas, and charming cottages.

verified_facts.text: Citrus Club rooms and suites include lounge access before check-in and after check-out, complimentary food, a dedicated concierge and priority reservations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Select a Citrus Club room or suite to enjoy additional exclusive benefits, including:

verified_facts.text: Room rates include a mandatory charge of 59 US dollars per night.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Price includes $59.00 USD** mandatory charge per night, but excludes taxes and government charges

verified_facts.text: Villa suites come with a kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Villa One Bedroom Suite - Full Kitchen

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a multi-day Southwest journey with a private flight to Page, Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend, and lunch on Lake Powell.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on an exclusive private aviation experience departing from Deer Valley Airport aboard a scenic flight to Page, Arizona.
